notes.title: Starnded B v1.0
notes.content:
Stranded B  v1.0
We are now in the full version.
There will continue to be updates if you send me bugs or requests.


You can now hold down the button on the axe and pickaxe
Swimming animations more realistic
Vegetation added
Settings menu expanded
Post processing added to switch yourself

notes.title: Stranded B..eta
notes.content:
Now comes the Beta version of Stranded B

We're almost at the finished game. There will be a few more updates to come before the game is finished, but we're getting there.
The alpha version can still be downloaded and played.
Important:
A new game must be started!


Performance improved
Graphic update
new islands on a huge map
Raft
additional animations
new audio effects
new water system
new underwater wildlife

performance improvement

notes.title: Hunting and Weapons
notes.content:
Welcome to the new update!
This is about hunting new animals on additional 2 new islands with new weapons.
Use the bow or other firearm to kill the animals both on land and in the air.
On  "Costa De Porky"  you will only find peaceful pigs.
Now it's getting dangerous, because on  "La Isla Boscosa"  you will also find wolves and bears, so be careful.




[olist]
  Costa De Porky (new island)
  La Isla Boscosa (new island)
  Firearm
  new animals
  Animals can now be gutted with a knife (further loot)
  Mushrooms and herbs can be cut off with a knife
  additionally new trees and terrain textures
[/olist]
